newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bastia Jan-Aug air freight/ mail traffic up 5.9pct.
newsitem.headline: Bastia Jan-Aug air freight/ mail traffic up 5.9pct.

text.p: Bastia's Poretta airport handled 1,309 tonnes of airfreight in the first eight months of 1996, an increase of 5.9 percent on the same period last year.
Air France Europe is the principal airline operator at Bastia with daily passenger services between Paris-Orly and the northern Corsican city using Airbus 320 series aircraft.

Bastia is also served by French airline, Air Littoral, which operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft.
The HS748 operates a nightly Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio to Marseille flight
January-August 1996 postal traffic handled at Bastia airport totalled 3,868 tonnes, up 15 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said.
French carrier, L'Aeropostale, carries postal freight between its Paris-CDG hub and Bastia using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.
